description: Thresholds for the Pharos redemption-backed asset gate

require_redemption_available.description: When true, an asset with no working direct redemption route denies outright.

approved_route_families.description: Pharos redemption route families the curator will accept (e.g. 'issuer-direct', 'authorised-participant').

approved_access_models.description: Pharos redemption access models the curator will accept (e.g. 'permissionless', 'kyc-gated'). Governs who may redeem.

approved_settlement_models.description: Pharos settlement models the curator will accept (e.g. 'same-day', 't-plus-one'). Governs how quickly redemption settles.

required_route_status.description: The route status the asset must report to be admissible, typically 'active'. Anything else - impaired, suspended, degraded - denies.

min_confidence.description: Minimum Pharos confidence (0-1) in the reported redemption route before the policy will act on it.

min_daily_limit_multiple.description: Minimum ratio of the route's daily redemption limit to the intended position. 2 requires the daily limit be at least twice the position, so it can be exited without queueing across days.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Pharos observation. Null ages from the oracle fail-soft and do not trigger this rule.
